the names of the full moons
and where they come from

wolf moon, january

named for wolves heard
howling in winter.

pink moon, april

named after early pink wildflowers,
not the colour of the moon.

strawberry moon, june

the season to pick
wild strawberries.

harvest moon

the full moon closest to the
autumn equinox.

beaver moon, november

when beavers finish
their winter dams.

cold moon, december

the longest nights
of the year.
